matched_conditions: candidate frozen before episode-2 external return
no candidate access to baseline or candidate episode-2 return
returned_metrics: distinct study-anchor coverage across admitted sources
mean relevance matches per admitted source
decision_rule: PASS_BOUNDED_RELATION_TRACE_QUERY only if candidate returns >=2 external centers and lexicographically improves (anchor_coverage, mean_relevance_matches, external_center_count, -query_token_count) over lexical baseline. Otherwise FAIL_OR_WITHHOLD.
internalization_rule: A public-development pass is insufficient for source removal. Internalization requires later fresh disjoint recurrence plus capability-specific source removal under the Internalizer boundary.
claim_fence: A pass shows only bounded returned query-relevance improvement over the frozen lexical reconstruction. It does not establish general semantics, general memory learning, WWW truth, AGI, consciousness, or promotion.
